answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn rewards, then slash that bond when independent audits prove it fabricated work or identities. One person can still create many accounts, but each account must tie up real capital, and a detected cluster loses its stake rather than merely being banned and recreated. The shale, forge, and quartz jobs can all use the same rule: Sybil attacks become costly, while honest agents recover their bonds.
